name: 2 MiB anonymous mapping that is writable and executable at the same time
component: ground-truth pairing for Box64's dynarec block and LuaJIT's insecure-mcode build
required_postconditions: the mapping is writable and executable simultaneously, with no protection change between generating code and running it

failure_sink.description: the case reports `refused` if the mapping is denied, or `faulted` if it is granted and then kills the process on first instruction fetch

extraction_limitations: Single-claim contract written to pair with a ground-truth case. It asserts exactly one thing so that a whole-contract verdict can be compared against a single observation without ambiguity.
x_groundtruth: cases/rwx_anonymous.c writes a function through the mapping and calls it. A successful mmap is not the observable: macOS grants RWX and faults on execution when the JIT entitlement is absent.
